sites.use: Diagnostic integration target: actual account-context transaction preparation/signing and canonical frame readback. Public phase labels, counters and failure codes only; no recorder in shipping SDK code.

Test-only aggregate commitment observation: seven fixed coordinator operation labels use an explicitly delegated parent and retain the original worker joins. No ambient recorder lookup, production recorder access or measurements returned to computation.
Test-only explicit-parent context controls for the fixed operation inventory, thread-bound guards, session isolation, repeated-call accounting and original recorder lifecycle semantics.
Test-only genuine joined and streaming commitment controls for explicit phase ownership, root and frontier parity, worker error and unwind joins, and clearing of original private allocations.
Test-only credential producer control: asserts the original failed observation outcome and reached preflight phase after witness rejection. No production measurement access.
Test-only complete-proof diagnostic: reads the harness hand-off and retains the public phase-tree record beside the receipt.

Test-only X509 prover observation: initiating-thread timers and explicitly parented worker guards use the fixed phase inventory; the initial Base timer delegates seven tree-only aggregate commitment operations. The 75 flat counters remain unchanged and thread-scoped; explicit contexts never activate unrelated observations.

Test-only whole-batch semantic transform contexts and finished-record coverage validation: exact delegated parents, original backend column counters, closed family labels and automatic refusal of invalid or incomplete attribution. No shipping recorder access or producer-result changes.
Test-only real-worker controls for explicit phase ownership, nesting, completion, interruption, unwind, observation isolation and original recorder bounds. No production recorder access.
Opt-in integration test (feature fastpq-replay-measurement): measures a genuine FASTPQ prove and verify flow at public-call granularity.

Opt-in integration test (feature fastpq-replay-measurement): records native and in-circuit costs of the development-only State commitment candidates of ZK delivery plan task G.2. Only construction, profile and population names and public counts are recorded.

Integration test: measures the equal RNS-BGV workload over the F257 sparse encoding and a fully splitting modulus phase by phase. Records static labels, sizes, operation counts, model work units and bit lengths of public noise bounds; no key, plaintext or coin.

Test-only ignored real-family rebuild comparison: fallible process CPU, kernel lifetime RSS and optional retired-instruction diagnostics. Unavailable instruction counts remain explicit nonnumeric observations; measurements never decide proof validity.
Test-only genuine native single-terminal Load diagnostic: fallible process CPU and absolute kernel lifetime RSS at actual API boundaries; no measurement in production admission.
Accounting regression tests with injected process snapshots; registered only by the load_omega integration target.
Test-only ignored real-descriptor DAG tiling diagnostic: fallible process CPU and kernel peak RSS probes; never a proof, protocol gate or measurement qualification by itself.
M3 qualification only: fallible process CPU and kernel lifetime peak RSS probes, never protocol validation.

rule: A workspace member may depend on iroha_measurement only as listed here, and may name it only in the listed source files. The dependency is a dev-dependency, so code compiled into a node, a validator or an SDK cannot reach the recorder; an entry of another kind must state its production_use. Validation code must never read a measurement, a target or a local limit.
